REPUBLIC OF VANUATU
TRADEMARKS ACT NO. 1 OF 2003
Declaration of Convention Countries
Order No.4() of2012
In exercise of the powers conferred on me by subsection 107(1) of the Trademarks
Act No. I of2003, I, the Honourable Ham Lini VANUAROROA, Deputy Prime
Minister and Minister of Trade, Tourism and Industry, make the following Order.
1 Declaration of Convention countries
The foreign countries listed in the Schedule are declared to be Convention
countries for the purposes of the Trademarks Act No. I of2003.
2 Commencement
This Order commences on the day on which it is made.
